* Working closely with our Sales, Customer Service and Production teams to achieve outstanding customer outcomes

As your skills develop, you'll have opportunities to contribute to customer artwork, branding projects, new product development and continuous improvement initiatives.

## About you

We're looking for someone who is passionate about creativity and excited to learn.

You don't need years of experience—we'll provide full training—but you do need the right attitude and a genuine interest in graphic design.

You'll be a great fit if you:

* Have a genuine passion for graphic design and creativity
* Enjoy problem solving and thinking visually
* Have an excellent eye for detail
* Take pride in producing accurate, high-quality work
* Enjoy learning new software and skills
* Are organised and able to manage multiple tasks
* Communicate well and enjoy working with others
* Are reliable, motivated and eager to build a long-term career
* Thrive in a fast-paced environment

It would be great if you also have:

* Basic knowledge of Adobe Illustrator or Photoshop (school, TAFE or personal projects all count)
* A portfolio of school work, personal projects or creative designs (not essential but highly regarded)
* Completed Year 12 (preferred but not essential)

## What you'll gain

This is much more than an apprenticeship.

You'll receive:

* A nationally recognised Graphic Design qualification
* Full on-the-job training and mentoring from experienced designers
* Experience using industry-leading Adobe Creative Cloud software
* Exposure to the latest digital print and garment decoration technology
* Real-world design experience from day one
* Opportunities to work on artwork for well-known Australian brands, sporting clubs and businesses
* A supportive team that genuinely wants to see you succeed
* Long-term career opportunities within a growing Australian company

## Why join Velflex?

Velflex is a proudly family-owned Australian business with a reputation for innovation, quality and exceptional customer service.

Our mission is to deliver industry-leading heat transfer solutions while helping our customers succeed through exceptional products, education and support.

Everything we do is guided by our core values of **Respect, Resilience, Trust, Honesty and Pride**.

When you join Velflex, you'll enjoy:

* A supportive, family-owned team culture
* Modern production and design facilities in Brendale
* On-site parking
* Barista-quality coffee every day
* Regular team BBQs, celebrations and social events
* Company uniforms provided
* Ongoing training and professional development
* Career progression opportunities as the business continues to grow

## Hours

This is a full-time apprenticeship based at our Brendale facility.

Standard hours are **Monday to Friday**, with training provided entirely on-site alongside our experienced Graphics team.

## Ready to start your creative career?

If you're passionate about design and want to turn that passion into a rewarding career, we'd love to hear from you.

Please apply with your resume and a short cover letter telling us why you'd like to become a **Graphic Design Apprentice** at Velflex.

If you have a portfolio of school projects, personal artwork or creative work, we'd love to see it—but it's not essential.

Start your design career with a team that's passionate about creativity, innovation and helping people grow.

result.description:
On behalf of our client, we are looking for a full-time, experienced Heavy Duty (HD) Diesel Fitter. 

The Heavy Duty Diesel Fitter is responsible for carrying out mechanical maintenance, inspections, fault diagnosis, and repairs on heavy duty mobile plant, machinery, and production equipment used in industrial and operational environments. The role focuses on maintaining plant availability and reliability through planned maintenance and timely response to mechanical failures, in accordance with workplace health and safety, environmental, and quality requirements.

Key Responsibilities
• Execute planned and preventative maintenance activities in accordance with maintenance schedules, work instructions, and engineering standards
• Inspect, service, maintain, and repair heavy duty mobile plant and equipment, including trucks, loaders, drills, ancillary plant, and production support equipment used in industrial operations
• Diagnose mechanical and hydraulic faults using appropriate diagnostic tools, instruments, and procedures
• Remove, overhaul, repair, or replace mechanical and hydraulic components such as pumps, cylinders, valves, drivetrains, suspensions, braking systems, and structural assemblies
• Perform precision fitting, alignment, and adjustment of components to ensure correct operation and tolerances
• Lubricate machinery and maintain fluid systems in accordance with manufacturer and site requirements
• Respond to plant breakdowns and unplanned maintenance events to restore equipment to operational condition
• Safely use lifting equipment, hydraulic jacks, and workshop machinery to handle large assemblies and components
• Conduct routine inspections to identify wear, defects, or emerging mechanical issues
• Recommend corrective and preventative measures to improve plant reliability and reduce unplanned downtime
• Collaborate with supervisors, planners, and other maintenance personnel to coordinate maintenance activities
• Maintain accurate maintenance records, job reports, and inspection documentation
• Comply with all workplace health and safety, environmental, and quality management systems
• Participate in hazard identification, risk assessments, and incident reporting processes

Skills and Experience
• Demonstrated experience maintaining and repairing heavy duty mobile plant, machinery, and industrial equipment
• Strong mechanical fitting background, with sound knowledge of hydraulics and associated mechanical systems
• Experience diagnosing faults in complex plant and machinery environments
• Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, manuals, and specifications
• Competence using hand tools, precision measuring equipment, hydraulic testing tools, and workshop machinery
• Strong problem solving skills and attention to detail
• Ability to work autonomously and as part of a multidisciplinary maintenance team
• Commitment to safe work practices and compliance with site standards

Qualifications and Requirements
• Recognised trade qualification as a Mechanical Fitter, Diesel Fitter, or equivalent engineering trade
• Certificate III in Engineering (Mechanical Trade) or equivalent
• Relevant high risk work licences or plant tickets (desirable)
• Current driver’s licence
• Ability to meet site medical and fitness for work requirements
• Commitment to complying with WHS, environmental, and quality systems

Salary range: $85,000 to $100,000
